L1-48.qualitative_note: Longer outputs often become prose or hit the 160-token cap. p04 omits the hospital; p50 emits task instructions before a refrain.

L4-35.qualitative_note: Often very short without the field: p18 is two sea-adjacent lines and p33 is five words. p43 is a fuller lyric-shaped exception; p50 lacks the growing refrain.

L5-35.qualitative_note: More sustained than L4-35, but p01 and p04 still hit the cap in prose, p18 wrongly places the beacon by the sea, p33 is five words, and p50 lacks a growing refrain.

interpretation: L5-35 does not depend completely on an explicit length field: it averages 70.7 words versus L4-35 at 36.8 with the field omitted. Both retain 10/11 lexical topic hits, but obvious completion and prompt-fit failures remain. This secondary set has no requested length, so adherence is not measured.
limitations: The same concepts may have different sampled text because removing the field changes the model input; fixed seeds and generation parameters are held constant. Internal reading is not independent scoring.
